links.outcome: Emergency sensitivity and critical misses in triage of vignettes across systems
links.effect: Emergency sensitivity 46.7% for Healthdirect vs 80.0% to 86.7% for LLMs; Healthdirect had two critical misses, no LLM had any across 270 evaluations (95% CI 0% to 1.4%).
links.quote: Healthdirect produced two critical misses; no LLM produced any across 270 evaluations (95% CI 0% to 1.4%).

links.outcome: Triage accuracy of LLMs versus existing government symptom checker on same vignettes
links.effect: Healthdirect 48.9% accuracy (kappa 0.233) versus 73.3% to 86.7% for LLMs (kappa 0.600 to 0.800); Cochran's Q = 36.79, p < 0.001.
links.quote: Healthdirect achieved 48.9% accuracy (95% CI 35.0% to 63.0%; kappa = 0.233) versus 73.3% to 86.7% for LLMs (kappa = 0.600 to 0.800).

unlisted_practices: Comparing free versus paid subscription tiers of LLMs for triage safety (no significant differences)

screen.reason: Empirical comparison using clinical vignettes evaluating triage safety and accuracy of LLMs versus an existing symptom checker tool.
